source.place: Lemma 36.3.9(2), with 06YG and 00LS; ambient computation before pullback

proof.text: Use the natural linear equivalences c_U between algebraic self-Tor and affine sections of the ambient homology sheaf. These assert only section coordinates and the restriction equation.

The closed structure sheaf pushforward B is quasi-coherent because a closed immersion is affine. Its single object has quasi-coherent cohomology: degree zero is B, all other degrees are zero. Apply the canonical derived tensor quasi-coherent closure to infer quasi-coherence of Q, then restrict to each chart.

The normalized affine chart section equivalence d_U identifies the associated chart sheaf sections with algebraic Tor and proves quasi-coherence on the chart. Extend d_U inverse followed by c_U, and its inverse, to morphisms on the affine chart using the library affine Hom API. Affine Hom extensionality proves the two composites are identities. Use overEquiv to obtain t_U, with the prescribed top-section normalization.

Apply naturality of t_U to the inclusion V into U, replace its value on the normalized top section by c_U(x), apply the section-coordinate restriction equation, and use the normalization of t_V. This proves the required equation for every supplied augmented comparison.

proof_origin.place: Section coordinates, quasi-coherence from 08DX(1), affine reconstruction from sections and naturality; 01IB (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent) for reconstruction
